# A book whose cost basis stands for currency the accounts no longer hold.
#
# 1,000.00 USD are bought, 400.00 of them are sold against that cost basis, and
# the purchase split states `cost_basis_balance: "1000.00"`. A stated balance is
# what that cost basis holds once the file has landed — it is how a book
# carrying sales gnucash-plaintext never saw gets one — so the statement stands
# and the drawdown does not, and the book is left offering 1,000.00 USD against
# a bank holding 600.00.
#
# Nothing refuses it as it lands: the figure is inside what the split brought
# in, which is what the rule on a stated balance asks. What finds it afterwards
# is `--verify-integrity`, which reads the cost bases against what the accounts
# hold and reports the 400.00 that is gone.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_verify_integrity_checks_whether_a_book_is_consistent_and_balanced.py.
2031-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2031-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2031-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2031-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2031-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2031-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2031-01-01 open Equity:Opening
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2031-01-01 open Income
	type: "Income"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2031-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: "Income"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2031-01-05 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "13/10"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

price
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	time: "2031-06-30 12:00:00 +0000"
	value: "7/5"
	source: "user:price-editor"
	type: "last"

2031-01-02 * "Opening capital"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 5000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening -5000.00 CAD

# The stated balance is the whole 1,000.00, so the sale below draws nothing off
# it as far as the finished book is concerned.
2031-01-05 * "Buy 1,000.00 USD at 1.30"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank 1000.00 USD
		guid: "d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d40001"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "1300.00"
		cost_basis_balance: "1000.00"
	Assets:CAD Bank -1300.00 CAD

2031-06-30 * "Sell 400.00 USD at 1.40"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Bank -400.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "13/10"
		value: "-520.00"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d4d40001"
	Assets:CAD Bank 560.00 CAD
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
